fact: The Annuaire statistique d'état civil 2024 (covering 1 January to 31 December 2024; produced yearly since 2014, the 2023 edition cited as its predecessor) compiles births, adoptions, marriages, divorces and deaths from three administrative sources: civil registration centres (sous-préfectures, mairies, embassies and consulates), public health facility reports (DHIS 2, Direction de l'Information Sanitaire) and court returns (Tribunaux de Première Instance and sections), with ANStat population projections as denominators.
title: Annuaire statistique d'état civil 2024
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Sécurité, DESPSE
